facts.text: Amanyara is on the quiet northwest tip of the island, about 25 minutes from Providenciales.
facts.excerpt: Amanyara is located about 25 minutes from Providenciales, on the quiet northwest tip

facts.text: The resort lists a 25-minute drive transfer from Providenciales International Airport (PLS).
facts.excerpt: 25-minute drive

facts.text: The resort borders Northwest Point National Park, which is good for birdwatching and exploring underwater caves.
facts.excerpt: It borders Northwest Point National Park, which is excellent for birdwatching and exploring a network of underwater caves.

facts.text: Amanyara opened in 2006 as the first Aman property in the Caribbean.
facts.excerpt: It opened as the first property in the Caribbean from luxury resort portfolio Aman back in 2006

facts.text: The name Amanyara combines Aman, meaning peace in Sanskrit, and Yara, meaning place in the language of the Arawak people who once lived on Turks and Caicos.
facts.excerpt: Amanyara is a portmanteau of Aman, meaning ‘peace’ in Sanskrit, and Yara, meaning ‘place’ in the language of the Arawak people who once lived on Turks and Caicos.

facts.text: The resort's tranquil structures channel Aman's Asian roots and are heavy on timbers and bamboo.
facts.excerpt: The sprawling resort just outside Providenciales channels the brand’s Asian roots in its tranquil structures, heavy on timbers and bamboo, as well as its signature spa.

facts.text: The resort has one- and two-bedroom pavilions and three- to six-bedroom villas.
facts.excerpt: the resort consists of one-to-two bedroom pavilions and three-to-six bedroom villas

facts.text: Each villa has its own pool, golf cart parking and outdoor area.
facts.excerpt: Each villa has its own pool, golf cart parking, and outdoor area.

facts.text: Beach Sala Villas sit on the sand, with direct beach access via a private beach sala extending from the terrace.
facts.excerpt: Beach Sala Villas are located on the sand with direct access via a private beach sala extending from their terrace.

facts.text: Beach Path Tranquillity Villas reach the beach within a three-minute walk along a dedicated footpath.
facts.excerpt: Beach Path Tranquillity Villas offer access to the beach within a three-minute walk via a dedicated footpath.

facts.text: Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host and Chef who stay on site for the duration of every stay.
facts.excerpt: Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host and Chef that stay on-site for the duration of every stay.

facts.text: The cost of food is not included in a villa stay, whether dining in the resort restaurants or in the villa.
facts.excerpt: The cost of food is not included, whether dining in the resort restaurants or in the villa.

facts.text: Villas other than the Beach Sala and Beach Path villas are about seven minutes by golf cart from the resort's public areas.
facts.excerpt: All other villas are approximately seven minutes by golf cart to the resort's public areas including the main Restaurant, guest experience pavilion, Boutique and Beach Club.

facts.text: Dining centres on The Restaurant with ocean-view terraces, The Bar and the seasonal Beach Club.
facts.excerpt: oversees a team across three main places to eat, including The Restaurant, where tables spill out from an open-walled dining area across terraces with fantastic ocean views, The Bar, and the seasonal Beach Club

facts.text: The resort's restaurants are open to Aman guests only.
facts.excerpt: Restaurants are open to Aman guests only.

facts.text: The resort has four clay Har-tru tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: Four clay Har-tru tennis courts

facts.text: The resort has a fully equipped Pilates studio and a Boxing studio.
facts.excerpt: Fully equipped Pilates studio and Boxing studio

facts.text: The spa has four treatment rooms, a relaxation pavilion, an outdoor yoga sala and a pool.
facts.excerpt: Comprehensive spa with 4 treatment rooms, a relaxation pavilion, outdoor yoga sala and pool

facts.text: The Six-Bedroom Amanyara Villa has a private gym and a steam room in the primary guest pavilion.
facts.excerpt: the Six-Bedroom Amanyara Villa features a private gym and a steam room in the primary guest pavilion

facts.text: The resort runs a kids program called Nature Discovery, with sailing and mountain biking for older kids and sailing and kitesurfing lessons for younger kids.
facts.excerpt: kids program called Nature Discovery, where older kids can go sailing and mountain biking while younger kids can learn to sail and take kitesurfing lessons

facts.text: The resort is flat and wheelchair-friendly, golf carts take guests around the property, and the villas are almost all single-level.
facts.excerpt: The resort is wheelchair-friendly and flat; golf carts are on hand to escort guests around the property, and villas are almost all single-level.

facts.text: Water toys at the beach include snorkels and paddleboards.
facts.excerpt: The resort has a stash of water toys at the ready, including snorkels to admire the turtles and beautiful fish, as well as paddleboards

facts.text: One Condé Nast Traveler reviewer found the stone floors extremely hard, and watched for wet feet from the pool or bath.
facts.excerpt: the floors are made of stone and extremely hard. So I was always on extra alert when there were wet feet going back and forth, be it from the pool or bath.
